note: Undergraduate programmes and total credits from the programme list bubt.edu.bd embeds in every page, plus the four diploma-holder (DH) tracks that list leaves out, each from its own programme page; school is the faculty its academic hierarchy files the department under. Every total matches the admission page's Spring 2027 fee table (bubt-admission-fees), which lists Textile (DH) nowhere. Program codes are Shohoj's; names are BUBT's. Only name, credits and duration in the embedded list are real: its curriculum and semester-breakdown fields are template text (BBA in Accounting lists "Introduction to Programming"). Graduate programmes (MBA 66, LL.M 41, M.Sc. CSE 40, M.Sc. Economics 40, MA in ELT 40) are left out, as for the other campuses. termSystem: Law follows the bi-semester calendar, every other programme the trimester one (bubt-calendar-263).
